description: Implementation of DeviceInfo class providing device details such as serial number, model, manufacturer, device type, system info, network interfaces, MAC addresses, firmware version, and supported audio ports, with external dependencies on system files, scripts, and APIs.

classes.name: DeviceInfoImplementation
classes.description: Class implementing device information retrieval functions such as serial number, model, manufacturer, device type, system info, network addresses, MAC addresses, firmware version, and supported audio ports.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the device info implementation with the provided service.

methods.name: SerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the device serial number, attempting MFR data first, then RFC data.

methods.name: Sku
methods.description: Retrieves the device SKU/model number from device properties or MFR data or RFC data.

methods.name: Make
methods.description: Retrieves the device manufacturer from MFR data or device properties.

methods.name: Model
methods.description: Retrieves the device model name, with special handling for certain device names.

methods.name: Brand
methods.description: Retrieves the device brand, from a file or MFR data.

methods.name: DeviceType
methods.description: Determines device type from configuration files and maps to internal enums.

methods.name: SocName
methods.description: Retrieves the SoC name from device properties.

methods.name: DistributorId
methods.description: Retrieves distributor ID from a file or RFC data.

methods.name: ReleaseVersion
methods.description: Determines device release version from /version.txt or defaults.

methods.name: ChipSet
methods.description: Retrieves chipset name from device properties.

methods.name: FirmwareVersion
methods.description: Retrieves firmware version details from /version.txt and MFR data.

methods.name: SystemInfo
methods.description: Gathers system info including uptime, RAM, CPU load, hostname, and time.

methods.name: Addresses
methods.description: Enumerates network interfaces and their IP/MAC addresses.

methods.name: EthMac
methods.description: Retrieves Ethernet MAC address via script.

methods.name: EstbMac
methods.description: Retrieves Ethernet set-top box MAC address via script.

methods.name: WifiMac
methods.description: Retrieves WiFi MAC address via script.

methods.name: EstbIp
methods.description: Retrieves set-top box IP address via script.

methods.name: SupportedAudioPorts
methods.description: Retrieves list of supported audio output ports.
